cost: All stage costs plus the terminal Riccati penalty. Savings are ratios of paired mean costs.
construction: Toy feeder is the first eight buses of the existing tree. Larger feeder repeats both original radial arms with a shared fixed slack. Roles, line impedances and scheduled phases are copied. Toy budget is two remote links per inverter, otherwise three.
limits: Synthetic feeders, not standard utility test cases. Larger network is a repeated feeder, not arbitrary topology scaling. Four predefined reliability settings and five predefined seeds are reported in full. Similar qualitative mechanisms do not guarantee identical rankings.
